metadata.question: Was the Swannanoa River visibly browner on October 2, 2024, than on August 30, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for visible color assessment) - Location: Swannanoa River, North Carolina, USA (near Asheville) - Dates: August 30, 2024 and October 2, 2024 (specific dates) - Need to assess "brownness" - likely due to sediment/turbidity after Hurricane Helene (late Sept 2024) 2. Masking strategy: - Should NOT mask clouds heavily since we need to see the actual water color - Need clear pixels over the river to assess color - If too cloudy, may need to expand date range slightly 3. Logic for brownness: - Brown water = high sediment = higher red/NIR, lower blue - Can use: Red/Blue ratio, or turbidity index, or visual RGB comparison - Compare metrics between two dates - Valid zero would be if ratio is actually similar (Answer B) - C3 if we can't calculate due to clouds/no data over river - Need to ensure we have valid pixels over the river itself 4. Approach: - Define river geometry (point or small polygon on Swannanoa River) - Get images for both dates (may need ±2 days buffer) - Calculate brownness index (Red/Blue ratio is simplest) - Compare values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Swannanoa River location (near Asheville, NC) const riverPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-82.5273, 35.5951]); const riverBuffer = riverPoint.buffer(100); // 100m buffer for river sampling // Date ranges with small buffer const date1Start = '2024-08-28'; const date1End = '2024-09-01'; const date2Start = '2024-09-30'; const date2End = '2024-10-04'; // Load Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(riverPoint) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(riverPoint) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Aug 30 images: ${size1}, Oct 2 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Insufficient images for comparison."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get best images (least cloudy over AOI) const img1 = col1.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); const img2 = col2.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // Calculate brownness index (Red/Blue ratio) // Higher ratio = browner water const brownness1 = img1.select('B4').divide(img1.select('B2')).rename('brownness'); const brownness2 = img2.select('B4').divide(img2.select('B2')).rename('brownness'); // Calculate statistics over river area const stats1 = await brownness1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: riverBuffer, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await brownness2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: riverBuffer, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const brown1 = stats1.brownness_mean; const count1 = stats1.brownness_count; const brown2 = stats2.brownness_mean; const count2 = stats2.brownness_count; console.log(`Aug 30: Brownness=${brown1?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Oct 2: Brownness=${brown2?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count2}`); if (!count1 || count1 === 0 || !count2 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels over river area."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (brown1 == null || brown2 == null || isNaN(brown1) || isNaN(brown2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if October image is significantly browner const increase = ((brown2 - brown1) / brown1) * 100; console.log(`Brownness increase: ${increase.toFixed(1)}%`); if (brown2 > brown1 * 1.15) { console.log("Oct 2 was visibly browner (>15% increase)."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("No significant brownness increase detected."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
